notes.title: Major Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Battles now begin directly on the field without screen transitions when encountering enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New stages added and most existing stages have been remade[/p][/*][*][p]Skills of most card girls have been rebalanced or updated[/p][/*][*][p]Some card girls have received name or image changes[/p][/*][*][p]New Actions and puzzle elements have been introduced[/p][/*][/list]
